title: localrun.config.json
description: The dependency graph written by 'lrun build', read by plot, pack, verify and up. Safe to edit by hand between steps; build rewrites it from scratch.

SchemaVersion.description: Shape of the file. Absent in files written before 0.5.1, which read as 1. A version newer than the lrun reading it is refused (config-invalid).

RootPath.description: The directory build scanned, absolute. Project paths are relative to it.

LocalNugetPath.description: The local NuGet feed pack and go write into, absolute.

Projects.description: The projects kept, in topological order: dependencies first.

Name.description: The csproj file name without extension: the key filters and dependencies use.

PackageId.description: The id it is packed under (<PackageId>, else <AssemblyName>), only when it isn't the name.

SolutionPath.description: Full path of the first solution referencing it; its commands get its $(SolutionDir). Null when none does.

Type.description: executable when <OutputType> is Exe, else library.

LatestVersion.description: The highest version on the project's NuGet sources and the local feed; pack starts from it. Absent with build --csproj, or when none was found.

Dependencies.description: Names of the projects and packages it references, kept in the config or not.

ProjectVersion.description: A version split as Major.Minor.PatchAndSuffix: 1.4.3-dev.2 is 1, 4, "3-dev.2".

PatchAndSuffix.description: The patch number, then the prerelease label and build metadata if any.
